slug: 2024-11-05 Togo - Integrating DHIS2 with existing EMIS systems

facts.fact: The DHIS2 implementation profile says Togo's education ministry, supported by Norad, GPE KIX and HISP West and Central Africa, is piloting DHIS2 alongside the StatEduc application that holds school data collected on paper forms, with dashboards for enrolment, teacher-pupil ratios and exam results.
The pilot draws on school data entered into StatEduc by the education ministry's inspectorates.

systems.owner: Ministry of Primary, Secondary, Technical Education
